description.en: Attaches one character/object handle to a bone on another character, so it follows that bone's position and rotation (e.g. a hand prop following a character's hand bone).
Handle of the object to attach.
Handle of the character to attach it to.
Name of the bone on the parent to attach to, e.g. "r_a4".
True once the child has been attached to the parent's bone; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 3 arguments) or if either handle doesn't resolve to an existing character.

example.code:
// Attach a phone prop to a character's right hand bone
CMND_SET_PARENT(hKeitai, hTsurugiL, "r_a4");
